resources.string: This image is not Budokai Tenkaichi 2 (USA, SLUS-21441). Budokai Tenkaichi 3 is installed on the BT3 tab.
That was a Budokai Tenkaichi 2 image: it is ready on the BT2 tab.
In the game, press back twice to return to the app.
Included: BT2 Recomp, the game\'s code recompiled for Android.
BT2 draws with Vulkan 1.3 (paraLLEl-GS): Adreno 600 and newer, Mali G57 and newer. On Adreno a custom driver (Drivers page) can help.
Packs in PCSX2\'s format for SLUS-21441
Copy the pack\'s folder (the one that holds \"replacements\") into this folder with a file manager or adb:
Changes apply from the next game start.

BT2\'s engine reads the disc image itself, so it has no file-override mods like BT3\'s yet. Images with mods that only change data (textures, models, sounds) and keep the original SLUS_214.41 work: pick them on the Home page. Mods that change the game\'s program do not, because the engine runs code recompiled from the original program.
The game\'s own picture in 16:9 instead of 4:3.
Pictures between the fights\' 30 frames. Heavy: for strong GPUs.
Cheat codes are not supported by BT2\'s engine yet.
Native is the lightest. Smoothed keeps the resolution and softens edges; High and above draw at twice the resolution and need a strong GPU.
Sharp pixels; off: the picture fills more of the screen.
Written every few seconds (Debug page); not on the picture yet.
Simpler drawing of heavy see-through effects (fog, glows). Faster on weak GPUs; may change some effects slightly.
Textures always at full detail, without their smaller copies. Can be faster; distant surfaces may shimmer.
Every BT2 run is logged: the device, the GPU and the settings when it starts, the engine\'s messages when it ends.
Save the BT2 report to Downloads
The last ten runs\' logs are kept in bt2/user/runs, in the app\'s folder.
The driver chosen here is used by BT2 only; BT3 keeps its own.
